pages.text: Tools created using the Philosopher's Stone and Origins.$(br2)The Origin of Courage creates the Seven Swords of Terminus, the Origin of Hope creates The Destroyer of the Rial, and the Origin of Love creates fuel that burns forever.

Crafted at the Transcendental Table using the Origin of Courage, Panakeia swords, a Unite Alloy sword and other materials.$(br2)Repeated hits kill the target, and attacks also strike nearby enemies in front of the wielder. It does not break from durability loss.$(br2)It can be upgraded into the $(l:singularity/constellation_treasury)Constellation Treasury$(/l) at a smithing table.
A pickaxe that can be created with the Origin of Hope. $(br)Right-click to remove a bedrock, shift+right-click to place a bedrock.
Fuel that can be created with the Origin of Love.  $(br)It literally burns forever.
